**Meetings**
Organizational Meeting, Tuesday, January 14, 2014, 7:00 p.m., Services Building, 4420 Livernois, Troy, Michigan 48098; Regular Meeting the same evening at Athens High School, 4333 John R. District offices at 4400 Livernois, 248.823.4000. Meetings cablecast on TS-TV Channel 19 (Comcast) and Channel 15 (WOW) and posted at http://vimeo.com/troyschools. Public comment is limited to one-half hour for agenda items and one-half hour for non-agenda items, three minutes per speaker.

**Organizational business**
Election of an acting chairperson; appointment of Judy Holmes as temporary secretary; election of President, Vice President and Secretary for terms until December 31, 2014, with four votes required for election; appointment of Mark S. Rajter, Assistant Superintendent, Business Services, as nonvoting Treasurer for January through December 2014; designation of Superintendent Barbara A. Fowler, Ph.D., as Deputy Secretary; designation of Judy Holmes to post meeting notices; and adoption of the 2014 meeting calendar, which runs from February 4 to December 2, 2014 plus January 13, 2015, with ten workshops and the June 3, 2014 Annual Recognition Meeting at Athens High School.

**Depositories and investments**
Depositories named: Bank of America, Bank of New York, JP Morgan Chase Bank, Citizen's Bank, Comerica Bank, Fifth Third Bank, MILAF (Michigan Liquid Asset Fund Plus) managed by PFM Asset Management, Inc. through Fifth Third Bank, PFM Securities, Inc., and PNC Bank. Checks carry the facsimile signature of Treasurer Rajter; health-care claim checks over $10,000 require an additional handwritten signature from Jasen Witt or Monica Papasian. Investments follow Board Policy D-1103, with funds combinable under Section 380.1223(1)(h) of the Revised School Code.

**December 3, 2013 minutes**
President Philippart convened at 7:00 p.m. at Troy High School; Ms. Underwood was absent and roughly 100 audience members attended. Ten public speakers addressed the unsettled teacher contract. Resolution 13-097 approved the consent agenda; Resolution 13-098 authorized issuance of the 2014 School Building and Site Bonds in an amount not to exceed $56,000,000; Resolution 13-099 cancelled the December 17, 2013 workshop. All passed Yes 6, No 0, Absent Underwood. Closed session ran 8:26 p.m. to 8:29 p.m.; adjournment at 10:02 p.m.

2014_058_011414org_regmtg.verbose:
Troy School District, 4400 Livernois, Troy, Michigan 48098 (248.823.4000), assembled this Board of Education packet for Tuesday, January 14, 2014, covering both the annual Organizational Meeting at the Services Building, 4420 Livernois, at 7:00 p.m. and the Regular Meeting at Athens High School, 4333 John R. Standing boilerplate notes that meetings are cablecast on TS-TV Channel 19 (Comcast) and Channel 15 (WOW) every Monday and Wednesday at 2:00 and 9:00 p.m. when school is in session, with video at http://vimeo.com/troyschools, and that public participation is limited to one-half hour for agenda items and one-half hour for non-agenda items, three minutes per speaker.

**Organizational Meeting.** Superintendent Barbara A. Fowler, Ph.D., supplied the agenda memo: the previous year's president conducts the election of an acting chairperson; Judy Holmes is appointed temporary secretary; nominations for President, Vice President and Secretary need not be seconded and four votes are required for election, each office running until December 31, 2014. Roll-call name lists include Fleming, Hauff, Miletti, Philippart, Schmidt, Underwood and Edmunds. By Board Policy the treasurer is appointed annually as a nonvoting officer; the resolution appoints Mark S. Rajter, Assistant Superintendent, Business Services, as Treasurer for January through December 2014. Other items designate the Superintendent as Deputy Secretary for the 2014 calendar year and name Judy Holmes, Secretary to the Superintendent of Schools, to post meeting notices.

**Depository and investment resolution** (January through December 2014, adopted 'this 14th day of January 2014,' certified for Oakland County, Michigan). Depositories: Bank of America, Bank of New York, JP Morgan Chase Bank, Citizen's Bank, Comerica Bank, Fifth Third Bank, MILAF (Michigan Liquid Asset Fund Plus) managed by PFM Asset Management, Inc. through Fifth Third Bank, PFM Securities, Inc., and PNC Bank. Withdrawals are by check with the facsimile signature of Treasurer Rajter; in emergencies Rajter or Superintendent Fowler may sign by hand on the General Fund and Payroll accounts at Bank of America. PNC Bank accounts for Troy Career Center expenses are signed by the Career Center Manager, Assistant Manager or Program Coordinators. A Bank of America account pays remaining health care claims, with checks over $10,000 requiring the additional handwritten signature of Jasen Witt, Assistant Superintendent for Human Resources, or Monica Papasian, Finance Director. A Comerica Bank account for flexible spending claims is drawn by ACH debit to Next Generation Enrollment, Inc. Investments follow Board Policy D-1103, and the Treasurer may combine money from more than one fund under subsection (1)(h) of Section 380.1223 of the Revised School Code. Authorized investment institutions add Charter One Bank, Flagstar Bancorp and Morgan Stanley Smith Barney.

**2014 calendar.** Regular meetings at the Services Building, 4420 Livernois, 7:00 p.m.: January 14, February 4, March 4, April 1, May 6, June 3 (Annual Recognition Meeting at Athens High School), June 17, July 8, August 5, September 2, October 7, November 11 and December 2, 2014, plus the January 13, 2015 Organizational and Regular Meeting. Workshops at the Administrative Center, 4400 Livernois, 6:00 p.m.: January 21, February 11, March 18 (at GROW), April 22, May 20, June 10, September 16, October 21, November 18 and December 16, 2014.

**December 3, 2013 minutes.** President Philippart called the meeting to order at 7:00 p.m. at Troy High School with Edmunds, Fleming, Hauff, Miletti and Schmidt present, Underwood absent, administrators Keeling, Lesser, Machesky, Mull, Rajter and Witt in attendance, and approximately 100 additional audience members. Student representatives Michaela Smith (Athens High School) and Patty Durell (Troy High School) reported on the fall play, holiday concerts, the sophomore Snow Glow Dance and student government sales of typhoon relief bracelets for the Philippines. Ten speakers addressed the teacher contract: Tiger Bawa, Sunny Patel, Carolyn Brown, Tom Herbon, Bruce Dow, Scott Gibbons, Tony Lucchi (president of the TEA), Leslie Robare, Luis Bello Espinoza and Betsy Murphy. Resolution 13-097, moved by Mr. Hauff and supported by Mrs. Fleming, approved the November 12 and November 19, 2013 minutes and the October 2013 Treasurer's Report, Yes 6, No 0, Absent Underwood. Mr. Witt updated the Board on mediation and fact-finding, with the District's proposals posted on the District website. Mrs. Anne Mull, Director, Assessment and Instruction, reported on the state's fall 2013 Top to Bottom Rankings and Accountability Scorecards, released in August 2013 by the Michigan Department of Education, noting that Michigan's flexibility from the federal No Child Left Behind Act means Adequate Yearly Progress will no longer be reported. Resolution 13-098 authorized issuance of bonds designated the '2014 School Building and Site Bonds' in an amount not to exceed $56,000,000, Yes 6, No 0, Absent Underwood. Resolution 13-099 cancelled the December 17, 2013 workshop. Dr. Fowler reported that first-round design meetings with TMP Architects were complete and wrap-up meetings would finish by December 13th, with schematics to be reviewed at the January 21st workshop. The Board entered closed session under the Michigan Open Meetings Act, Public Act 267, Section 8(c) at 8:26 p.m., reconvened at 8:29 p.m., and adjourned at 10:02 p.m. Minutes signed by Paula Fleming, Secretary.

**Regular Meeting action items.** Board Recognition presents each member a gift representing the community. Mr. Jasen Witt gives a negotiations update requiring no action. Four Schools of Choice resolutions for the 2014-2015 school year cite Section 105 and Section 105c of the State School Aid Act of 1979 as amended by Public Act 300 of 1996: 50 nonresident kindergarten and 25 nonresident first-grade students under each of Sections 105 and 105c, and 26 nonresident sixth- through eighth-grade students for Baker Middle School under each section, with the 105c middle-school version covering districts in another county whose intermediate school district is contiguous with Oakland Intermediate School District boundaries. Under Board Policy B-2001, Workshops and Conferences, the Board considers approving Board President Philippart's attendance at the National School Boards Association Annual Federal Relations Network Conference in Washington, D.C., February 2-4, 2014; Troy Schools was one of six districts selected by the Oakland County School Board Association to receive a $500 scholarship as reimbursement. The Board also considers a service contract with the Michigan Association of School Boards to conduct the superintendent search, discussed at the January 7, 2014 Special Board Workshop, with no dollar figure stated. The meeting closes with a resolution to enter closed session on negotiations under Public Act 267, Section 8(c), with roll call listed as Philippart, Schmidt, Underwood, Edmunds, Fleming, Hauff and Miletti.
